title: Chest pain
reference: NASA ISS Medical Checklist (CHeCS) - Cardiovascular Emergencies & AHA Acute Coronary Syndrome in Austere Environments.

q1.text: Is the crew member conscious, responsive, and breathing without acute gasping or collapse?

i_cpr.text: IMMEDIATE CARDIAC ARREST CODE: Secure patient to Crew Medical Restraint System (CMRS) backboard. Attach Defibrillator/AED pads immediately. Initiate high-quality chest compressions (100–120/min) using microgravity overhead handholds.

t_cpr.text: Deliver 2 minutes of continuous CPR, then pause 5 seconds for automated AED rhythm analysis and shock advisory.

q2.text: Is the pain a heavy, crushing substernal pressure radiating to the jaw, neck, or left arm, accompanied by diaphoresis (cold sweats)?

i_acs.text: SUSPECTED ACUTE CORONARY SYNDROME: Place in semi-recumbent posture. Administer chewable Aspirin 325 mg (if no allergy/bleeding), attach high-flow O2 mask, and prepare sublingual Nitroglycerin (if systolic BP > 100 mmHg).

t_ecg.text: Record full 12-lead ECG telemetry strip and monitor vitals (BP, HR, SpO2) every 2 minutes.

q_shock.text: Is systolic blood pressure dropping below 90 mmHg or heart rate > 110 bpm (signs of cardiogenic shock)?

i_shock.text: CRITICAL CARDIOGENIC SHOCK: Cease nitroglycerin immediately. Position patient horizontal with legs elevated. Prepare IV Normal Saline resuscitation line.

q3.text: Does the chest pain sharpen distinctly with deep breathing (pleuritic), coughing, or manual palpation over the ribs?

i_musculo.text: MUSCULOSKELETAL / PLEURITIC STRAIN: Likely microgravity exercise countermeasure strain (CEVIS/ARED) or costochondritis. Auscultate bilateral lung fields to rule out pneumothorax. Administer oral Ibuprofen 400 mg.

i_eval.text: ATYPICAL CHEST PAIN: Record vital signs (BP, SpO2, HR). Rule out gastroesophageal reflux, musculoskeletal spasm, or localized cabin atmospheric contamination.

end_monitor.text: Pleuritic or musculoskeletal strain managed. Log symptoms in crew health journal, rest for 4 hours, and repeat vital signs check.

end_escalate.text: CARDIAC EMERGENCY PROTOCOL ACTIVE: Flight Surgeon telemedicine channel streaming. Continuous ECG rhythm and defibrillator standby maintained.
